fee_confusion.headline: Users are not disputing the price level. They are confused by the asymmetry between buy-side and sell-side charges, and read the larger sell-side debit as being charged twice.
fee_confusion.reconciliation_note: A multilingual keyword scan of the same sample finds 25 fee-mentioning reviews. That matches the classifier's fee-topic total (25) and exceeds its T1 theme count (24) by 1. The gap is the known discrepancy below, independently corroborated rather than reconciled away.
fee_confusion.root_cause: DP charges are levied only when shares leave the demat account, so they apply on sell transactions and not on buys; stamp duty applies on the buy side only. The sell leg therefore normally costs more than a comparable buy leg.

known_discrepancies: Fee-topic labels total 25 while theme T1 totals 24; one review carries a fee topic without the T1 theme. Flagged, not silently reconciled.
methodology_note: Stratified random sample (seed 42) of 1,000 from 10,000 collected public Google Play reviews, stratified by review week and rating. Counts are theme assignments within this sample, not estimates of the Groww customer base. A review may carry up to 2 themes, so theme counts sum above the number of classified reviews.
